name: form-conversion-calculator
description: Calculates form conversion funnel metrics: page-to-start rate, start-to-completion rate, overall page CVR, monthly closed deals, and revenue. Compares impact of improving form start rate vs completion rate by 20% to identify the higher-value fix.

formStarts.description: Visitors who interacted with the form (form_start events)

closeRate.description: Lead-to-customer close rate as a percentage

dealValue.description: Average deal or order value in EUR
